name: First Card Co
old_description: With the larger companies, you don’t get the attention like you do at First Card. You can tell it is a family-owned and operated business.
about:
First Card Packaging, a family-owned and operated business based in East Providence, Rhode Island, has served the packaging needs of companies large and small for over 30 years. The company emphasizes personal attention that distinguishes it from larger competitors.

The company produces a range of custom packaging products, including jewelry cards, tags, tickets, labels, boxes, inserts, point-of-purchase displays, loss-prevention packaging, supply items, and specialty designed products. Its six-step process guides clients from project conception through final inspection and shipment, with production scheduling and sampling available.

First Card Packaging works with businesses across the jewelry and retail sectors, counting brands such as Shawn Paul Jewelry and Float Jewelry among its customers. The firm serves both large and small companies, tailoring solutions to each client’s branding and packaging challenges.

Founded on a commitment to service that extends from the sales desk to the shop floor, the company differentiates itself by assigning representatives who spend time understanding each customer’s unique needs and collaborating with the production team to refine solutions based on feedback.
